dedupe_keys.name: data driven and user centric tools for a more resilient and inclusive public transport

description: The documented computational application integrates descriptive, predictive and prescriptive methods developed in ILU. Its functions include spatiotemporal and emerging traffic-pattern detection, graph/recurrent forecasting, dynamic multimodal OD inference and comparisons of public/private transport vulnerabilities. The reported OD statistics include walking, waiting, travel time and transfer counts. The source explicitly states that the planning tools were developed and validated with Lisbon partners, but does not establish a currently accessible hosted app or public integrated code release. Related individual algorithms and input data retain their own identities; component availability does not establish access to the whole suite. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
